description: Transfer an assigned task to another eligible contributor in the current project. The current assignee is supplied as a compare-and-set expectation; a stale view fails closed. Only the project owner, release manager, or editor may transfer, and the target must be an owner, release manager, or editor. Cycle membership is preserved and the change is recorded in the append-only ownership ledger. Does not call the Anthropic API.

new_assignee_id.description: User UUID of the eligible contributor who should receive the task.

name: task_transfer
